author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Levels of AI literacy
Level 0 - you are still struggling to use AI to get something done
Level 1 - know how to use your favorite frontier AI to get something done.
Level 2 - know how to use any frontier AI to get the same thing done
Level 3 - know how to use cheaper or open source AI to get it done, able to make trade off in cost and quality
Level 4 - you train your own AI to get it done
Level 5 - you still remember how to do it without any AI

comments.text: Level 6: You retire from software engineering, cancel your internet subscription, throw away all of your computers, buy a goat, plant a garden, and live off the land for the rest of your days. 😂
